aspect: Rebuilding what you already paid for once
description: The same family pays for the house, then for the repair, then in taxes for the national reconstruction, and receives a rebuilt building that is worth less than the one that stood there.
energy_note: Buying your own house three times.

aspect: Insurance does not cover acts of war
description: War exclusion clauses are standard. Every private policy a household holds becomes void for exactly the event that occurred.

aspect: The compensation scheme, if there is one, arrives years late and partial
description: Registration windows, documentary requirements and valuations at pre-war prices in post-war currency mean that most claimants receive a fraction, several years after they needed it.
energy_note: Paid a quarter of it, four years later.
